Lambson family · Person

Barnabas Lamson / Lambson

c. 1602–c. 1640

Open in the family tree

Left England for Massachusetts Bay in 1635 and settled in Cambridge, where he held land and served in town government. His reported passage on the Defence still needs passenger-list confirmation.

Family connections

Spouses and partners Marie (Mary) Liggett

Children with Marie (Mary) Liggett: Barnabas Lamson Jr., Joseph Lambson, Martha Lamson Rice, Mary Lamson Cooke, Sarah Lamson Crouch
